ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_: Go to the glass tree dome in the east of town (south of the rest home), step in through the airlock on its west side and walk up to Sandy Guh.
Step onto the karate mat in the dome. Sandy Guh shoves: when she shouts HAI, step aside or jump. Dodge her ten times. If she gets you, that one simply doesn't count.

With the last KABOOM three parts of Sandy's rocket flew into town: the nose cone (by the Jelly Field in the northeast), the exhaust pipe (behind the little houses on the West Ring) and the antenna (between the houses of Conch Street). Walk over them to pick them up.
Bring the three parts to Sandy's broken rocket, in the tree dome next to the tree.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_zij_vliege: Go to the mooring of The Flying Guhchman: the ring of stones with the little sign, east of Patguh's rock on Conch Street. Stay on the stones until the ship comes: ten counts, shown above your hotbar.
Step into the bubble stream at the mooring: it takes you up to the deck. Walk over to the ghost captain there.

The captain's three lanterns blew away: one among the Crumb Jellies in the field east of the mooring, one behind The Grease Bucket (north of the mooring) and one by Spongeguh's Nibble Chorus Fruit house, in the west. Walk over them.
Go back to the mooring. The ship comes again (five counts): take the bubble stream up and bring the captain his lanterns.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_zij_zeemee: Go to the rest home in the east (north of the tree dome; the door is on the west side) and walk up to Mermaid Guh and Barnacle Guh.
Mermaid Guh's belt is in the invisible boatmobile, on the car park on the south side of the rest home. Search nothing for something and pick up the belt.
Bring the belt back to Mermaid Guh, inside the rest home.
Drive the invisible boatmobile to the front door of The Krusty Nibble (west of the rest home, on Main Street) and pick up the heroes' lunch.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.beloning.spooklan: A ghost lantern and its recipe
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.dank.1: My lanterns! All three! Now I can find my way through the mist again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.dank.2: And the best part: when I saw them glow, I scared myself silly. At last I've given somebody a fright!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.dank.3: Here, take one with you, and the recipe too. Then it'll be a bit spooky at your place as well. BOO! Bye!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.klaar.o: You got a ghost lantern and its recipe
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.klik: Boo. We'll talk on deck, living guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.lantaar: All three! Back to the mooring: the ship will come and fetch you again.
The captain counts along from his deck: %s out of %s. Boo.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.na.1: BOO! ...Did you jump? No? I'm still practising.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.na.2: My lanterns burn like never before. Spookily pretty, huh?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.terug.o: Take the bubble stream up to the deck.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.guhlander.wacht: The ghost ship is coming... %s. Stay on the mooring.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.1: MY BELT! Click... I can feel it already: my powers are coming back! I feel twenty years younger!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.2: Thirty, chief. You hadn't worn it for thirty years.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.3: Time for a heroic deed! The most dangerous one of the day: fetching lunch from The Krusty Nibble!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.band.4: Take the invisible boatmobile, young hero. It's outside. I think. Toot toot!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.bonk: BONK! You walk into something that isn't there. The invisible boatmobile!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.dank.1: Lunch! Saved! Just in time for our afternoon nap.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.dank.2: Another town full of happy tummies. Good work, young hero.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.dank.3: You deserve this: a real hero cape. Wear it with pride! ...And wash it now and then.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.klaar.onde: You got the hero cape (guh clothes)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.klaar.tite: Mermaid Guh and Barnacle Guh: done!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.klik.lunch: Two meals. Mine without the pickle, please.
Lunch, young hero! At the front door of The Krusty Nibble! Toot toot!
The car park on the south side. You'll feel it right away. Literally: bonk.
My belt! It's in the invisible boatmobile, out on the car park. Go, go!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.later.moss: He means: we're not ready yet. Come back when you work in town.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.later.zeem: MERMAID GUH! Er... come back later, young hero. After my nap. And after your first day at work.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.lunch.onde: Two Nibble Patty meals. Back to the rest home!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.lunch.teru: Bring the heroes' lunch back to the rest home, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.na.mosselg: He fell asleep with his belt on again. Progress.
Thanks for lunch. It was the most exciting thing we've done in weeks.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.na.zeemeer: MERMAID GUH! ...Sorry, I just have to shout that now and then.
That cape suits you, young hero. Almost as well as it suits me.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.riem.onder: Bring it back to Mermaid Guh in the rest home.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.helden.toet: Toot toot! You're driving the invisible boatmobile.

gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.guhlander.1: Step into the bubble stream at the mooring, %s: it takes you to the deck of the ghost ship.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.guhlander.2: The nearest ghost lantern is %s. Follow the column of light and walk over it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.guhlander.3: Back to the mooring, %s. The ship comes again: up to the captain!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.0: Sandy Guh lives in the glass tree dome %s. Go in through the airlock on its west side.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.1: Step onto the karate mat in the tree dome, %s. Sandy shouts HAI? Step aside or jump!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.2: The nearest rocket part is %s. Follow the column of light and walk over it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.sandy.3: Bring the parts to Sandy's rocket in the tree dome, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.0: Mermaid Guh and Barnacle Guh live in the rest home %s. The door is on the west side.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.1: The invisible boatmobile is on the car park %s, on the south side of the rest home. The belt is in it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.2: Bring the belt to Mermaid Guh in the rest home, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.hint.zeemeerman.3: Toot toot! Drive the invisible boatmobile to the front door of The Krusty Nibble, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.binnen: Paintings of Octo hang everywhere. All of Octo. Made by Octo.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.0: Octo, serious, with his clarinet. The frame is bigger than the painting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.1: Octo, even more serious, in front of a sunset. He sighs, even on canvas.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.2: Octo as a marble statue. Underneath it says: Masterpiece.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.portret.3: Octo painting a painting of Octo painting a painting.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.stem.1: (from upstairs) Who's touching my clarinet?! That's a work of art, not a toy!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.octo.stem.2: (from upstairs) Sigh. Even my clarinet sounds better when I play it. A little bit.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.open: Bikini Bottom is alive! Sandy Guh in her tree dome, the ghost captain of The Flying Guhchman and the old heroes in the rest home could use your help. Look in your Guhdex under Tales, below Spongeguh Cheesepants.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.helm_op: Your air helmet is on. Blub.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.gera: A gentle shove! That one doesn't count, nothing else happens. (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.klaa: You're faster than a jellyfish on roller skates!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.pauz: Paused: step back onto the mat to carry on. (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.karate.rege: She shouts HAI? Step aside or jump! Dodge her 10 times.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klaar.onder: You got the air helmet (guh clothes)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klik.karate: On the mat, buddy! Dodged: %s out of %s. HAI!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klik.onderd: Found: %s out of %s. Follow the column of light, they're all over town!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.klik.raket: You've got all three? Come along to the rocket!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.later: Hey there! I'm Sandy Guh. Sort out your job with Mr. Krabguh first, then we'll do karate, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na.1: A little karate every day keeps your ears supple!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na.2: I tried the rocket again. It went up a tiny bit again. Progress!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na.3: Nice little helmet you've got on. Suits you better than me, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na_karate.1: Wow! You're fast! Faster than a jellyfish on roller skates!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na_karate.2: Say, will you help me out? My rocket went KABOOM last week, and three parts flew out of the dome, into town.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.na_karate.3: The nose cone, the exhaust pipe and the antenna. Can you find them? Then we'll finish it together!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_zij.sandy.onderdeel.a: All three! Bring them to Sandy's rocket in the tree dome.
Visit Sandy Guh in her dome
To the rocket in the dome

scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.boe: BOOOOO! Who disturbs the eternal rest of The Flying Guhchman?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.boord: Come aboard, if you dare! My bubble stream takes you up to the deck. BOO. That was an invitation.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.kolom: Vous voyez? A bubble stream bubbles up, straight to the deck. The ghost ship is waiting for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.leven: A living guh! Nobody has come by in a hundred years. I'm rather out of practice with my boos.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_guhlander.mist: Ah... the mist is rising, mes amis. Look up. There, out of the mist... a ship!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.dichter: It came closer. Tok. Tok. A knife. A board. And sobbing, heartbreaking sobbing...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.kaars: A little later, on deck... by candlelight, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.lantaarn: But now something really scary: my three ghost lanterns blew away. Into town. All of them.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.nacht: It was a dark night. In a quiet kitchen. And then it came: tok... tok... TOK.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.titel: The Night of the Chopping Chopper
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.uien: He was chopping onions. For the soup. That's why he was crying so much. Hahaa! Scary, huh? Your little ears are still shaking!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.verhaal: Sit down, living guh. I'll tell you the scariest story of the seven voids: The Night of the Chopping Chopper.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_hakker.vraag: Without their light I'll never find my way back through the mist. Will you bring them back? I'll just blow you down.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.bezoek: A visitor! Have you come for an autograph? Or... have you seen a SUPERVILLAIN?!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.ga: Young hero! Find my belt! Go, go, GO! ...We'll just have a little nap.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.kwijt: My belt! It must be in the invisible boatmobile. On the car park, on the south side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.onzichtb: The trouble is, chief: the boatmobile is invisible. We'll never find it again.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_helden.riem: He hasn't put his belt on yet today, young hero. Without his belt he does nothing heroic. Except sleep.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_knabbel.te: Fetch the heroes' lunch here. Heroic, right?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_koepel.tek: A glass dome full of air, with an airlock on the west side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_lantaarn.t: Blown out of the mist. Walk over it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_mat.tekst: This is where Sandy Guh trains. She shoves, you dodge.
Flung away by the last KABOOM. Walk over it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_parkeer.te: The invisible boatmobile is parked here. Probably.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_raket.teks: A few more screws, then... WAHOOG?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_rusthuis.t: Two retired heroes live here. The door is on the west side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_stroom.tek: Straight up to the deck of the ghost ship.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_kijk_trap.tekst: A ring of stones and a sign: sometimes. Boo.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.grap: Haha, don't worry: guhs breathe anywhere. But you look sooo cute with a fishbowl over your little ears.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.hallo: Hey there, neighbor guh! Welcome to my tree dome! Take a look around: in here there's air. Real air!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.helm: Wait, your air helmet first. *plop* There!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.karate: But enough moping! Fancy a round of karate? On the mat over there. I shove, you dodge. HAI-YA!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.lucht: I built it all by myself. A glass dome, an airlock, and a Guhmension tree to sleep under.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy.roze: I'm from the Guhmension. The sky is pink and soft there. Down here I miss that a little sometimes, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.aft: Ready for launch! Three... two... one... WAHOOG!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.hel: Here, keep that air helmet. Then you'll always have a little piece of my dome with you. Thanks, buddy!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.ond: The nose cone, the exhaust pipe, the antenna! All three! Just a few screws...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.roz: One day I'll fly it all the way up, through the void, until the sky turns pink again.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_zij_sandy_raket.spr: It went up! It really did! A tiny little bit. A hop is a bit like flying too, isn't it?
